current_difficulty_reason: Equality of marked energies does not directly yield pointwise curvature rigidity from the prior equidistribution theorem. The authors first prove a uniform near-umbilicity estimate by normalizing nearly round quasicircles and excluding degeneration to a single ideal point, then derive vanishing of the normalized curvature defect along the selected surface sequence. That new geometric compactness/defect argument turns marked-data equality into a full-support rigidity conclusion, beyond merely applying the cited Plateau and equidistribution results.
